title: Which point becomes the root?
hook: Five points. One root. Where will the first cut land?

doesNotKnow: The root follows coordinate rank, not rectangle midpoint.

objective: Distinguish median point-count balance from spatial area balance.
misconception: A median split must divide a rectangle into equal areas.
